extDescription.message: Hides posts on Threads that mention keywords you choose. Comes with a preset for Asmongold and the Olympus guild.

profileBlocked.message: The profile @$HANDLE$ is blocked by Threads Keyword Filter.

optKeywordsHint.message: Case-insensitive. Checks post text, usernames, links and image alt text. The bare word "olympus" is left out on purpose (cameras, the mountain, etc.). Add it if you want broader blocking.

optBlockProfiles.message: Cover profile pages whose handle matches

optModePlaceholder.message: Collapse with a notice (click to reveal)
